title: At the table with John Mack in England on the day he died
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of At the table with John Mack in England on the day he died, about 2004 at England, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: England when he was there and I sat at the table with him and we talked about some stuff when he died that day

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest on a podcast about alien life, says that in 2004 he sat at a table in England with a man named John Mack and talked with him. He says Mack died that same day. He tells it as a personal last meeting with a figure well known in these circles.
